## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the shared behavior changed, without sample-specific workarounds.
- [ ] Standard build and packaged-app checks pass; packaging changes also pass in a fresh clone.
- [ ] UI changes include matching English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese strings.
- [ ] Icon changes were checked in the packaged sidebar, About page and native app icon.
- [ ] No customer data, passwords, keys, personal logs, private RAR downloads or app bundles are included.
- [ ] The staged public-tree audit passes and third-party notices remain intact.

RAR encoding coverage is optional and must be reported separately from the
public baseline. A passing baseline does not establish licensed RAR creation,
Developer ID signing, notarization or clean-machine acceptance.
